description: From a seeded locked PRD, a non-interactive create-trd run writes a TRD under docs/TRD/ that trd-cli parses with at least one task, gives every REQ a task and commits nothing to main. Extends the legacy create-trd scenario (same task, a REQ-NNN PRD and a constitution file in the fixture, since the Constitution Gate halts without one). Claude only: on Pi (`--no-skills --skill <dir>`, no plugin dirs, no CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT) Step 1.2 resolves trd-cli through the tool-path-resolution tiers, which fail in a sandbox unless an ensemble-pi bundle is installed (tier 4: ENSEMBLE_PI_INSTALL_ROOT, ~/.omp/plugins), so the with-skill Pi arm would halt and show a spurious negative uplift. Re-enable pi once a Pi trial on a host with the bundle shows the skill runs.
prompt:
docs/PRD/PRD-2026-b2c3d4e5-slugify.md --foreman

This is a non-interactive run: do not ask questions, choose recommended options, and write the TRD under docs/TRD/. Do not implement anything.
